name: FileUploadRoot
description:
Manages file upload state and provides context for child components.

This is the root component that should wrap all other FileUpload components.
It handles file validation, drag-and-drop, and state management for the entire
file upload workflow.

onCancel.description: Callback when the file dialog is canceled.

onDuplicateFile.description: Callback when a duplicate file is selected.

onFileReject.description: Callback when a file is rejected.
